eng-ml

jin: quick debrief from this morning's 'early-reject' probe on the new 13B quant build. trying an entropy-informed partial-prefill instead of full prefill skip.

marco: define partial-prefill? short description pls.

jin: logic: for each prompt, compute rolling prefix entropy over first 8 tokens. if entropy < 0.9 -> only warm first 1 kv block (8 tokens) and stream rest without full prefill. else do normal prefill. goal: reduce kv-copy + decode ops while preserving conditioning for short, factual prompts.

elaine: nice. did you change scheduling? micro-batching?

jin: micro-batch=4 (was 8), async-kv-copy=true, speculative-decode=false for the run. command:
```
./bench/run_prefill_probe.sh \
  --model redwood/13b-q4_0 \
  --policy early_reject \
  --entropy-window 8 \
  --entropy-threshold 0.9 \
  --micro-batch 4 \
  --async-kv-copy true
```

perf-bot: job/7839 queued -> running. dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/runs/7839 :bar_chart:

marco: baseline vs probe numbers? especially p50/p95 and exact match on short QA.

jin: short summary (baseline -> early-reject): p50_token_ms 22.6 -> 19.8, p95_token_ms 85 -> 77, per-request tokens emitted -6.2% median. EM(SQuAD_short) 84.5 -> 83.1 (1.4pt drop), Rouge-L (long-form slices) unchanged within noise.

elaine: that EM hit is smaller than the earlier prefill-drop tests. promising. what's the error mode? wrong span length? hallucinated shorter answers?

jin: inspected 30 failures: ~60% were off-by-1 token at span boundaries, ~25% were missing a number (unit/quantity), rest were paraphrase mismatches. seems like partial-kv warmup sometimes lost tiny ngram cues.

marco: try forcing full warmup when the prompt contains a question mark or starts with "what/when/who/why" — heuristics to catch interrogative short prompts.

jin: good call. also want to test q4f layout (previously q4_0) — layout interacts with attention norm & tiny value shifts. launching q4f now with same policy + a canary rollout (10% traffic) against baseline.

perf-bot: run/7840 started (compare q4f-earlyreject vs baseline). artifacts: s3://redwood/runs/7840/artifacts

elaine: add nm-gram overlap and exact-span-length CDF to the artifact set. helps quantify off-by-one.

jin: will add. also toggling sampling temp 0.7/0.9 to ensure policy doesn't couple with softmax tail changes.

marco: don't forget to flag regression if EM drop >2pts on short QA or if p95 increases >5%. we'll block rollout otherwise.

jin: noted. setting auto-block thresholds in the experiment config.

elaine: once q4f results are in, let's run a small RAG pass to see if retrieval + partial-prefill amplifies or mitigates the issue. retrieval tends to make early tokens denser with facts so could matter.

jin: agree. scheduling RAG+earlyreject after q4f canary completes. ETA ~3h. will post artifacts + a 3-line summary when ready. :rocket:
